issues.where: the swirling storm in the liquid and the lower interior of the globe
issues.what: the storm is drawn as sparse, stiff tan scratch lines and blurry white cotton smudges over a dim interior, leaving the dark pond, pebble ring, grass and sunflowers starkly exposed instead of veiled in a glowing vortex
issues.fix: replace the coarse tan strokes and cotton blobs with a dense, luminous 3D vortex of hair-thin golden-white filaments and crisp pappus wisps, and add strong warm backlit scatter across the lower globe so glowing turbulence veils the pond, shoreline and lower cottage

issues.where: the background inside the globe behind the cottage, streetlamp and tree
issues.what: the clearing behind the diorama is pitch black instead of filled with warm golden-cream sunlit mist, making the interior look dark, cut-out and unlit
issues.fix: add the bright warm golden-cream low-sun haze behind the streetlamp, cottage eaves, tree base and right lawn so warm light wraps the silhouettes, lights the grass and reflects golden-amber in the pond

issues.where: the sandstone base, the collar under the glass and the embedded shells and sea glass
issues.what: the base is a tall, symmetrical, flat-lit grey-tan bell with a high flat collar, a tall blank upper band, and flat opaque inlays sunken into dark holes instead of sculpted warm sandstone with glowing translucent sea glass and proud 3D shells
issues.fix: seat the sphere lower into a scooped collar with a recessed shadow and sunlit overhanging stone lip, sculpt asymmetrical layered sandstone lit by warm golden raking light on the left and cool slate-blue shadow fill on the right, and make the sea glass thick and translucent with transmitted caustic glow alongside raised, glossy ribbed shells

issues.where: the glass rim, the upper-right shoulder reflection and the sunstar
issues.what: a thick muddy amber band runs inside the upper-right rim and a milky yellow band lines the left rim, with no clear crystal wall thickness, no curved sky-and-treeline reflection on the right shoulder, and a soft blurry flare instead of a crisp sunstar
issues.fix: remove the heavy painted amber inner band, render a clear double-walled crystal rim with cool clarity at the crown and subtle edge refraction, add the curved sky-and-horizon reflection on the right glass flank, and sharpen the upper-right highlight into a bright white-cored multi-rayed starburst

issues.where: the dandelion seeds and firefly depth planes in the liquid
issues.what: the dandelion seeds look like thick, chalky white radial asterisk stamps clumped in the upper-left quadrant, and all glowing particles sit in sharp focus with no soft out-of-focus bokeh orbs
issues.fix: render delicate, gossamer translucent pappus filaments on slender stems at varied angles and depths spread evenly around the dome, and add larger soft out-of-focus yellow-green and golden bokeh discs

issues.where: the cottage roof, chimney, front doorway, window and climbing vines
issues.what: the roof has glossy dark-brown stripes instead of matte slate shingles, the chimney is too tall and narrow, the door is bright orange-red with no stone arch, and heavy bright-green bushes bury the warm four-pane left window
issues.fix: use a matte dark slate-grey shingled roof with overhanging eaves shading the upper gable stone, shorten the grey stone chimney, frame a darker recessed wooden door in a curved stone arch, thin the greenery into delicate ivy with pale peach-pink roses, and uncover the bright warm four-pane window

issues.where: the tree trunk, tree crown, sunflowers and left wooden fence
issues.what: the trunk is nearly black instead of warm brown lit by the lanterns, the crown is dark emerald peppered with noisy yellow dots, the sunflowers are flat cartoon discs on rigid stems, and the left fence sits in dark shadow
issues.fix: warm and sculpt the brown bark in the lantern glow, render soft layered olive-and-moss foliage pads with golden rim lighting instead of pixel speckles, replace the cartoon flower discs with translucent backlit petals on natural stems, and spill warm lower-left rim light across the fence and grass

issues.where: the inner shoreline rim and pond edge inside the globe
issues.what: the front ground inside the glass is a coarse crunchy gravel ring and the pond is outlined by a uniform necklace of small grey pebbles around a cold white reflection
issues.fix: replace the coarse gravel ring with fine, velvety pale sand lit warmly on the left, break up the uniform pebble border into irregular mossy bank stones on the left and overhanging grass tufts, and warm the pond reflection to amber-gold

issues.where: the sand cascade on the right of the base, the surface sand and the mirror foreground
issues.what: the falling sand on the right breaks into coarse floating tan dots above a blurry mound, harsh dark stipple dots edge the surface sand, and beige sand covers the front crease and bottom-right corner where the dark wet surface should reflect
issues.fix: turn the right spill into dense, fine backlit sand streams feeding a sparkling grain-textured mound, remove the dark stipple noise and excess front/left dust, deepen the dark contact shadow under the base foot, and clear the dark glossy foreground on the bottom right to show the mirror reflection of the lit sand and base

issues.where: the background bokeh lights, right-side water glints and overall colour contrast
issues.what: the background bokeh circles on the upper right and left are dim, isolated flat beige discs, the lower-right surface shows dull vertical grey blurs instead of golden horizontal water ripples, and the overall palette is flatter and murkier
issues.fix: brighten and overlap the upper-right and left bokeh into hot cream-white cores with warm halation, add crisp warm golden horizontal water glints on the lower-right surface, and increase contrast between radiant white-gold highlights and cool deep-slate shadows

issues.where: the cottage window and the streetlamp inside the shaken globe
issues.what: the warm four-pane cottage window is dark and hidden and the streetlamp blurs away into a dull smudge, whereas in the target both glow clearly as focal anchors through the storm
issues.fix: keep the glowing four-pane cottage window and the dark streetlamp post with its warm lit lantern clearly readable through the swirling golden haze
